items.title: Phil Flanigan interviewed by Monk Rowe, San Diego, California, February 15, 1998
items.q: Paul Cohen is a lead trumpet player that used to play with Basie, Dorsey, Shaw, you name it.

ctx.x: Okay. Good answer. I understand that you’re getting into the school system down where you live and talk about jazz a little bit?

Yeah, let me give you a little background. About a year or so ago I started getting calls for these gigs by this small organization called the South Florida Jazz and Swing Society, based in Delray Beach, which is just north of Boca Raton where I live. Now there’s a whole bunch of retired people, if you look at that area demographically, there’s a whole bunch of older folks, so you’d think that the swing/jazz demographic would be there. Sure enough, it is. There is an AM radio station there that plays swing and…
I think the artists probably like having a musician in the role of doing some of the booking you know.
